title: Version 1.50.0
body:
Version 1.50.0

February 21st, 2024

Added:

  • Tree generation has been entirely rewritten, resulting in better performance and the ability to save trees on your property!
  • New hotbar system! You can now re-organize your inventory, and dropping things should be more intuitive
  • A new UI interface for health and oxygen has appeared! No more drowning without realizing.. Although, I'm not sure how you would've noticed you weren't DYING FOR OXYGEN BEFORE!
  • There is now an Aurora Borealis weather event!
  • Two new vinyls have been added to the game, can you find them?
  • New atmospheric sounds have been added to make the game more immersive
  • There is now wind effects, including wind lines and moving leaves

Changes:

  • Vehicle beds are now rewritten to be better. (strike 1...)
  • Crates are now entirely rewritten to be better. (strike 2!)
  • Elevators are now rewritten to be better. (3 strikes, you're out!)
  • The Large Bombs at the pirate ship are now much much cheaper (5000 -> 1200)
  • Vehicles can now be respawned without the need to hover over the button
  • The keybind for changing the mode of a calculator is now different due to accidental presses
  • Box quantity counts now display on all sides of the box for better visibility
  • Property selection should now be more smooth and automatically start on the first available property
  • Cauldrons can now have their particles and sound toggled on and off
  • The Menorah can now have the lights toggled on and off
  • Sliding doors now take way less material to fill (0.7 -> 0.4)
  • Modified some of the tutorial dialogue to be less obscure
  • The beach music is now different! (Cumbiac by Kevin Macleod)
  • Lowered the amount of normal mushrooms that spawn in the cave by 4x
  • The inspect menu viewport now rotates and also now has better lighting
  • The grabbiest grabber now has a blue light, similar to the grabby grabber
  • The underwater ambiance sound is now different
  • The ocean water now has transparency, hopefully you can see kelp and other resources easier now!
  • The default server time cycle now starts at 12 PM rather than a random time from 12 AM to 12 PM
  • Christmas Toy trains can now be picked up off of their track!
  • Rocks now slightly shrink when mined in order to prevent them becoming hard to drag out of their node
  • Tiny rock wedges no longer generate ore pieces
  • The Highlands now have a different grass color

Fixes:

  • A weird delay when an object first hits a sander should no longer happen
  • Supporter gamepass money should now be given
  • Rocks and trees should now spawn in the archway replacement for the tunnel
  • Objects with invisible colliders (such as a ladder) should no longer falsely trigger refinery/forge/etc output blockage
  • Signs should set their text color correctly for some darker materials such as Mythril
  • Conveyors shouldn't "stick" objects as easily anymore, hopefully, please. I need this. please
  • An issue where controller users couldn't use the advanced wire options should be fixed
  • Icestone is now slippery, yippee!!!!
  • Properties should no longer have a "height" limit
  • The Alignment Conveyor should no longer grab onto currently dragged items
  • An attempt has been made to fix pixel gaps that are created over time. This will not fix existing ones, sorry
  • Doors and other misc. schematics should now be able to be replicated in build mode
  • Many of the NPCs no longer show "None" for their dialogue prompt
  • Improved performance for store region respawning
  • Many of the vehicle inspection menus should now have the correct model shown in the viewport
  • The lamp head exclusive should now always work
  • When purchasing a boxed good with multiple quantity, it will now accurately reflect that in the purchase dialogue
  • Moving a toy train track off of your property will now result in the train converting back into it's item form
  • A bunch of small map fixes were made
  • There was likely a lot of stuff we forgot to note! We hope these changes help everyone out.

Version 1.50.1

February 23rd, 2024

Fixes:

  • Fixed tree generation not initializing properly, resulting in trees not dying / respawning on rare occurrences.
